<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
resolve_activation(name: str) -> Callable[[np.ndarray], np.ndarray]
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.reference`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/)

Return the activation callable registered under `name`.

## Parameters

- `name` · `str` — HF activation name, matched **case-sensitively** (HF's `ACT2FN`
  is case-sensitive too).

## Returns

- `Callable[[np.ndarray], np.ndarray]` — One of the callables in `ACTIVATIONS`.

## Raises

- `HFUnsupportedError` — If `name` is not a supported activation; the message
  names it and lists `sorted(ACTIVATIONS)`.
